finding: managed check/test children inherited the launching process stdin: mcp_server._run (MCP transport=stdio JSON-RPC stream), the agent_test_runner worker Popen and the affected_agent_tests run loop; a selected test whose fixture peer reads stdin to EOF consumed a piped sentinel and, with an open terminal-like pipe, blocked until its run_ssh timeout
controlledFailure: test_ssh_absolute_deadline and test_ssh_dispatch_retry stage peers consumed the caller sentinel through each launch point while reporting OK; an open stdin pipe made them raise TimeoutExpired

additionalFinding.finding: the managed pre-push ran the whole 808-module agent selection as one command, which outgrew its 50-minute per-command bound with no per-module results; failed-first reran an agent command without failed modules unchanged, removed modules included, and the check launcher SIGKILLed a timed-out child at once, so a runner's own-session workers outlived it and could overlap the next command
additionalFinding.controlledFailure: mcp_server.before.source plans the gate and one whole bulk command, reruns an unparsed command (a bulk command or a narrowed one-module rerun) unchanged so a removed module, reported as unittest.loader._FailedTest, keeps the failure set failed, and its _run sends a timed-out SIGTERM-trapping child SIGKILL without SIGTERM, leaving the child's own-session worker running
additionalFinding.sourceSelection: AST-selects run_checks, _run_check_commands, _commands_for, _record_check_outcome, _failed_modules, _failed_commands, _failure_set_path and _run with controlled globals over an inert owned root
additionalFinding.sourceNote: this beforeimage predates the stdin fix of the tree whose managed pre-push timed out; its planner, runner and failure-set functions equal that tree's and its _run differs only by stdin isolation, which the timeout regression does not use
